env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
# Both q's lint action and its dependency compile report this type error.
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-json
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=2 '"rule_id":"correctness::nil_deref_unproven"'
stderr -count=2 '^\{.*\}$'
stderr -count=2 '"file":"[^"]*q/q\.lgo"'
! stderr '(?m)^[^{\r\n]'
! stderr 'internal compiler error|panic|fatal'

env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-text
! logos lint ./...
stderr -count=2 '\[correctness::nil_deref_unproven\]'
! stderr 'internal compiler error|panic|fatal'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ownedlgo

go 1.27

-- m/p/p.lgo --
package p

import "example.com/ownedlgo/q"

var Name = q.Name

-- m/q/q.lgo --
package q

type User struct { Name string }
func Name(u *User?) string { return u.Name }
